_comment: Ground-truth Unicode label per Book 1 name-crop (books/book1/names/{id}.png). Built by cross-referencing data/book1_golden.jsonl (hand-typed names) with direct visual reading of the crops. Used by scripts/eval_ocr.py to score OCR engines. Ids are the Stage-3 parse ids. Note ids 8/9=㝵, 15/16=浼, 23/24=据 are cross-graph duplicate people (the same person repeated at a graph boundary; stitching merges them).
